thread:
Kai (Design): dropped a compact-vectors preview + export text update in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/preview-compact. Main asks: make the density toggle readable, clarify download flow copy, and define keyboard/ARIA for previews.
Maya (PM): nice. product asks: 1) show exact counts for <=10k, else show "10k+" shorthand, 2) CTA copy should be explicit about CSV.
Rohit (Eng): implementation notes: lazy-render previews when in viewport, and for export if rows > 5k switch to background job + notification link. client should never try to build a 50k CSV in-memory.
Lina (A11y): a11y quick notes: density toggle must be reachable by keyboard and have aria-pressed. preview expansion needs aria-expanded and focus move. modal should have role=dialog and initial focus on title.
Zoe (Product): microcopy suggestion: change "Export" -> "Download vectors (CSV)" and helper: "Only visible columns included. Filters and selection apply." Also add an option "Include rerank metadata" in rerank flows.
design-bot: contrast analyzer: density toggle text #5B6BFF on bg #FFFFFF passes AA large, fails AA small. Recommend #3F4EDC or bold text.
Kai (Design): updating the toggle color and CTA wording. Also mock the 10k+ state and selected-count in the pill.
Rohit (Eng): keyboard specifics: tab order: checkbox -> row -> preview-toggle -> actions. When preview opens, focus moves into preview header; ESC collapses and returns focus to the toggle. Arrow keys should move between previewed rows.
Lina (A11y): suggested ARIA for preview toggle:
```
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="preview-321" aria-label="Show vector preview for row 321">Preview</button>
<section id="preview-321" role="region" aria-labelledby="preview-heading-321" aria-live="polite"></section>
```
Also announce counts change: `aria-live="polite"` on the summary pill.
Maya (PM): timeline: need final copy + ARIA snippets by Tue so eng can scope for sprint.
Kai (Design): will push updates Mon EOD: color tweak, updated copy, 10k+ mock, and aria notes in the spec.
Rohit (Eng): will add server-side fallback for selection counts and background export hook. For background exports we'll include an email/push link and a job id.
Zoe (Product): small UX ask: in the export modal show an estimated size if possible (e.g., "~4.2MB") and a note for background exports: "We'll email you when ready."
Lina (A11y): final checklist: focus trap for modal, role=dialog, aria-live updates for counts and loading, aria-expanded/controls for preview. I'll run a screen-reader pass after design update.
Kai (Design): thanks everyone. closing once Figma updated and I'll post the updated file here :thumbsup:
